rationale: The revised plan adequately addresses the reviewer feedback and stays scoped to the reported PairGrid/MultiIndex issue. It now expands beyond `map_diag` to audit all PairGrid extraction sites, proposes a single PairGrid-local helper with explicit MultiIndex/tuple semantics, calls out duplicate-column behavior, includes `pairplot` variable inference and hue exclusion/membership checks, and sharpens the regression strategy to cover both low-level PairGrid mapping and high-level `pairplot`. It also explicitly avoids unnecessary broader grid changes, which matches the issue scope.
